title: Jobs in a Changing Climate
discussion_signal: The post presents evidence across 93 economies on job implications of climate change and the green transition, emphasizing labour-market frictions that can block job growth. It links climate adaptation to skills, mobility, and the distribution of opportunity rather than only emissions targets.
linked_research_question: How do climate exposure, skills, mobility, and labour-market frictions shape who gains or loses from the green transition?
limits: Individual summary of World Bank research
The post does not show country-level job outcomes
LinkedIn discussion is not a representative worker sample
